snippet.description:
Most people hate Flock cameras because of privacy concerns, but aren’t we already being surveilled through other methods in the US? Michigan congressional candidate Will Lawrence and Vox’s Astead Herndon discuss why the cameras strike a chord with Americans on this week’s episode of America, Actually. 

Listen wherever you get your podcasts, or watch here on YouTube, on Saturday.
